$comment: Golden vectors for APK_SERIAL_SETTINGS (contracts/rust/src/serial_settings.rs, contracts/python/apkaudio_contracts/serial_settings.py). `parse`: settings text -> label (null = refused). `pins`: a whole spec, the port asked about, and the label it resolves to (null = no pin). `rejected`: the entries a spec reports as unreadable. Cases taken from PLUGIN.VISA serial_hunter/pinned.rs and PLUGIN.SERIAL_COM exchange.rs tests, which held the two copies this replaces.

parse.label: 9600 7E2 none
parse.why: framing is case-insensitive; the label is upper case
zero baud is a typo, refused (the one tightening over the old copies)

pins.label: 9600 7E2 none
pins.why: no serial or name match: the default

pins.label: 4800 7O1 none
pins.why: the adapter serial follows the meter to whatever port it lands on

pins.label: 9600 7E2 none
pins.why: a /dev/ prefix on the key is ignored

pins.label: 19200 8N1 none
pins.why: within one rank the last entry wins

pins.label: 9600 8N1 none
pins.why: a rejected entry does not shadow the default
an empty key names no port

rejected.why: an entry with no '=' is skipped silently; one with '=' and bad settings, or an empty key, is reported
